Line.Description:
Line Item #2 – HVAC Equipment (Furnished)
This line item includes the complete furnishing of all HVAC equipment required to serve 50 residential units, including both the Historic School renovation and New Addition buildings, as well as associated common areas. Equipment selections are in accordance with the mechanical schedules and specifications outlined in the contract documents dated 10/31/2024 and include VRF systems, ERVs, ductless mini-splits, multi-position air handlers, and centralized domestic hot water heating systems.

Outdoor Units
Mitsubishi R2- and Y-Series VRF Condensers, including:

PURY-EP96TNU-A1, PURY-EP72TNU-A1, and PUHY-EP72TNU-A1 outdoor units

Hyper-Heat models with R-454B refrigerant to meet new refrigerant phase-out compliance

Single-Zone Heat Pumps (Mitsubishi SUZ, MUZ, PUZ series) in 12K, 18K, 24K, and 36K BTU capacities for various unit types

Indoor Units
Wall-Mounted Evaporators (PKFY, MSZ, PKA series) for studio and loft units

Ceiling Cassettes (PLFY Series) for common areas and select apartment zones

Multi-Position Air Handlers (SVZ Series) sized 12K–36K BTU, ducted, compatible with R-454B refrigerant

Total of 75+ indoor evaporators across the full project scope

Controls and Interfaces
Thermostats and Room Controllers:

PAC-YT53CRAU-J simple MA remote controllers

Alarm.com ADC-T40K-HQ thermostats or approved equals

Mitsubishi AE-200 and AE-50 Centralized Controllers

PAC interfaces, LEV kits, and M-Net adapters for full VRF integration

Thermostat interface modules (PAC-US445CN-1) provided per apartment zone

Domestic Hot Water System
Mitsubishi QAHV-N136TAU-HPB CO₂-based Commercial Heat Pump Water Heater

Complete water heating system includes:

Grundfos Magna 3 pumps

Lochinvar buffer tanks, Amtrol expansion tanks, Niles swing/storage tanks

SWEP heat exchangers and associated panel heaters

Factory-insulated and heat-traced drain pans per snow line clearance requirement

Accessories and Structural Supports
Quick Sling stands (QSMS/QSSB series) for all outdoor equipment (single- and dual-fan)

Snow hoods, hail guards, and wind baffles (SGN, SHK, WB series) for rooftop installation resilience

Refrigeration ball valves, panel heaters, and vibration isolation accessories included

Additional Notes
All equipment quoted includes factory-authorized start-up assistance by Mitsubishi-certified personnel.

All systems utilize the new R-454B refrigerant, in compliance with current environmental regulations and refrigerant phase-out.

Delivery coordination and staging per jobsite limitations and GC requirements.

All equipment shall be installed per manufacturer specifications, applicable codes, and project plans and specs.

Line Item #3 – HVAC Permitting
Includes all permitting fees required for HVAC installations across 50 residential apartments. This covers coordination with local authorities, submission of permit applications, and payment of associated fees to ensure compliance with municipal building and mechanical codes.
All Materials necessary to perform the job.

Line.Description:
HVAC Equipment Package
Location: 69 Central Ave, Falmouth

(1) LGKNSLA241A – LG Single Zone Multi-Position Air Handler, 24,000 BTU Indoor Unit

(1) LGKUSXA241A – LG Universal LGRED High-Efficiency Outdoor Unit, 24,000 BTU, Vertical Discharge

(1) LGPREMTA201 – Deluxe Wi-Fi Enabled Thermostat with Wired Configuration

(1) RSTES12 – 12" Universal Powder-Coated Aluminum Heat Pump Stand

Contracted Customers: Licensing / Permitting
Location: 69 Central Ave, Falmouth

This line item covers all required municipal licensing and permitting associated with the HVAC installation, including the following equipment package:

(1) LGKNSLA241A – LG Single Zone Multi-Position Air Handler, 24,000 BTU Indoor Unit

(1) LGKUSXA241A – LG Universal LGRED High-Efficiency Outdoor Unit, 24,000 BTU, Vertical Discharge

(1) LGPREMTA201 – Deluxe Wi-Fi Enabled Thermostat with Wired Configuration

(1) RSTES12 – 12" Universal Powder-Coated Aluminum Heat Pump Stand

As part of this scope, Manual J (load calculation), Manual S (equipment selection), and Manual D (duct design) are included in the pricing to ensure system design compliance with local code and optimal performance.

Labor
Location: 69 Central Ave, Falmouth

This line item includes all labor associated with the installation of the HVAC system, including:

Mounting and setting the LG 24,000 BTU Single Zone Multi-Position Air Handler (IDU) and LGRED High-Efficiency Outdoor Unit (ODU)

Installation and connection of the Wi-Fi enabled thermostat

Assembly and placement of the 12" universal aluminum heat pump stand

Refrigerant piping, electrical connections, and system start-up

Coordination with local inspectors and support during permitting process

All work will be performed in accordance with manufacturer specifications, local building codes, and best industry practices. Labor includes time allocated for system testing, commissioning, and homeowner orientation upon project completion.

This line item covers the cost of all materials and accessories required for the HVAC system installation, including but not limited to:

System mounting hardware and fasteners

Ductwork components, insulation, and sealing materials

Refrigerant lines and connectors

Electrical wiring and junction boxes

Condensate management and drainage components

Miscellaneous tools and supplies required for system setup and secure installation

These supplies are essential for the proper installation, performance, and compliance with local codes. All materials are selected to meet manufacturer requirements and industry standards, ensuring reliable, long-lasting performance of the HVAC system.

Payment Breakdown

To ensure a smooth and efficient project, the following payment schedule will be applied:

50% Deposit – Due upon project initiation to cover initial materials, labor, and preparation costs.

35% Progress Payment – Due after successful completion of rough inspection, indicating that the installation is proceeding as planned and in compliance with all relevant codes.

15% Final Payment – Due upon final inspection and project completion, after the system has been fully installed, tested, and ready for operation.

Line.Description:
@19 HATTIE LANE millis
Technical visit to perform system pressurization to check for leaks in the refrigerant lines. Includes replacement of the 3/8" and approximately 10 feet of the 1/2" refrigerant lines, which were found to be severely restricted or blocked. If additional leaks are identified during pressurization, repairs will be made as needed. In case a leak is located in the condenser or evaporator coil, a separate estimate will be provided for the repair or replacement of the affected component.
